snippet.title: STEP THEATER - Official Trailer - ステップシアター
snippet.description:
Subscribe to IndieBunny for the latest trailers, gameplay videos, credits and previews of indiegames here: https://www.youtube.com/@indiebunnycom

Step Theater blends rhythm gameplay with a narrative that advances with every beat, bringing the screen and story closer to success as you play. Charming visuals and a lively soundtrack make for a vibrant, drama-filled experience that rewards precise timing and immersion.
